Subject: Lightning Series: Technical Deep Dive — speaker prep & calendar lock

Hi Priya / Alex —

Thanks again for agreeing to join our Lightning Series (30-min technical deep dive) on July 23. Quick note to lock timing and alignment before I send the calendar invites to registrants. Proposed show flow below and a couple asks:

Proposed length: 30 minutes total
- 00:00–00:02 — Host welcome & intro (Marissa)
- 00:02–00:12 — Priya: architecture & real-world perf (10 min)
- 00:12–00:20 — Live demo / walkthrough (Priya + Alex)
- 00:20–00:28 — Live Q&A (moderated)
- 00:28–00:30 — Close & CTA

Asks:
1) Can you confirm you’re comfortable with the 10+8 minute split for speaking/demo?
2) Any AV requirements? (camera, slides, remote demo access, VPC access for the demo)
3) Please send a headshot + short bio for the registration page by Tue 7/14 EOD.

I attached a draft run_of_show (v3) and speaker guidance doc. We’ll do a 20-minute tech rehearsal on 7/22 (preferred) — can you confirm availability between 10:00–13:00 PT? If that window is rough, tell me 2x alternative times and we’ll accommodate.

Thanks — really excited to showcase your work with Acme.

—
Vanessa Ortiz
Field Marketing Manager, Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com
Redwood Inference

Hi Vanessa —

Thanks — excited to participate. 10 / 8 minute split sounds good. A few notes from our side:
- AV: we'll present from our staging laptop; we need a Zoom co-host so Alex can share his screen for the demo.
- Network: the live demo will query a small dataset in our sandbox. We'll need a one-time IP allowlist entry or a short-term token if Redwood prefers not to open IP ranges.
- Headshot & bio: sending those by EOD Tue (attached).

I’m available for a rehearsal on 7/22 between 11:00–12:30 PT (that works best).

On the run of show, one suggestion: swap the order so the demo follows a 3–4 minute quick architecture primer — that will make the demo flow better for an audience that hasn’t seen the stack. Happy to leave to your discretion.

-Pr

Dr. Priya Shah
Principal Data Scientist, Acme Analytics
